claim: Girona province holds 15 Michelin-starred restaurants with 20 stars total in the 2026 guide; El Celler holds 3 stars, Bo.TiC / Miramar / Les Cols each hold 2 stars.
quote: fifteen restaurants from the Girona province display the twenty stars with which they have been recognized by the prestigious Michelin Spain & Portugal Guide 2026

claim: El Celler de Can Roca accepts reservations up to 11 months in advance; new bookings open on the 1st of each month at midnight. Festival Menu: €315/person, wine pairing €155.
quote: Reservations are accepted up to a maximum of 11 months in advance. New periods open monthly at midnight (00:00 local time) on the first day of each month.

claim: 2026 marks El Celler de Can Roca's 40th anniversary; La Liste rated it 99/100 in 2026.
quote: 40 years of El Celler de Can Roca in Girona

claim: Bo.TiC address is Av. Costa Brava 6, 17121 Corçà; phone +34 972 630 869; Degustación menu €190, Chef's menu €250; 400+ wine list.
Bo.TiC occupies a 110-year-old restored carriage carpentry with 20 kitchen and dining professionals; Japanese microgreens from zero-miles grower Hidenori Futami.
quote: an old 110-year-old carriage carpentry that was restored in 2017

claim: Bo.TiC has two minimalist dining rooms, one with a chef's table overlooking the kitchen; inspectors particularly enjoyed the snacks on the menus.
quote: Behind the attractive garden are two minimalist-style dining rooms, one overlooking the kitchen (including a 'chef's table')

claim: Miramar (Llançà) opens Wed–Sat for lunch and dinner and Sunday lunch only; offers MAR and Memory, Territory & Culture tasting menus plus five seafront suites.
quote: Wednesday–Saturday: Lunch 1:15–2:00 p.m.; Dinner 8:30–9:15 p.m. Sunday: Lunch only, 1:15–2:00 p.m.

claim: Miramar, Passeig Marítim 7, Llançà; phone +34 972 380 132; founded 1939 by the Pérez family.
Les Cols tasting menu: €180 (incl. 10% VAT); optional wine pairing €65; optional cheese course €25; phone +34 972 269 209.
quote: Price: €180 (10% VAT included) / Optional wine pairing: €65

claim: Les Cols pavilions were designed by local RCR Arquitectes (Pritzker Prize laureates), using 30 cm-thick glass walls and zigzagging vegetal screens.
quote: Glass surfaces measuring 30 centimeters thick and three meters high are aligned rotating one with respect to the other, forming a zigzagging 'vegetal wall'

claim: Girona province total: 15 restaurants with 20 Michelin stars; El Celler ranked #1 in World's 50 Best in 2013 and 2015.
quote: occupied the first position in 2013 and 2015 according to Restaurant magazine

claim: Les Cols chef Fina Puigdevall has been running the restaurant for 30 years with a focus on humble Garrotxa produce including buckwheat and local potatoes.
quote: exceptional restaurant that chef Fina Puigdevall has been running for 30 years in Olot, in the Garrotxa region

claim: Girona city to Llançà (Miramar): ~63 km, ~49 min by car or 55 min by train.
quote: The train from Girona to Llançà takes 55 min including transfers and departs hourly.

claim: Girona city to Les Cols (Olot): ~51 km, ~43 min by car.
quote: it takes approximately 43 min to drive from Girona to Les Cols Pavellons, Olot

claim: El Celler employs 60 staff per service, maintains an 80,000-bottle wine cellar; smart casual dress code.
quote: The kitchen employs 60 staff members per service, reflecting the precision required for each dish's execution.

claim: Miramar's cuisine centres on the Mar d'Amunt (Alt Empordà sea) with avant-garde Mediterranean techniques.
quote: avant-garde cuisine with local heritage focus, Mediterranean flavors from the Alt Empordà region

claim: Girona city to Corçà (Bo.TiC): ~24 km, ~28 min by car.
quote: The driving distance between Girona to Corçà is 15 miles, approximately 28 minutes
